stem.text: The heart rate of a person at rest was recorded at intervals over two 15-minute periods.
During the first five minutes of the second 15-minute period, the person smoked a cigarette.
The graph shows the results recorded during the two 15-minute periods.

stem.alt: Line graph of heart rate in beats per minute against time in minutes from 0 to 15, on a grid, with two series labelled smoking for first five minutes and not smoking.

stem.text: What can be concluded from the graph?

A.text: Carbon monoxide affects the heart rate.

B.text: Carbon monoxide binds to haemoglobin increasing the flow of blood.

C.text: Nicotine increases the heart rate so is a stimulant.

D.text: The heart rate increases as a result of smoking.
